title: cicerbita chitralensis
intro: Cicerbita chitralensis, commonly known as Chitral dandelion, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cicerbita chitralensis are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
